requirements_summary: Goal: replace brittle retrieval layer with a production RAG pipeline for agent-assist + ticket summarization. Ingest sources: Zendesk tickets (12 months), Confluence KB, attachment PDFs in S3, product changelog DB. MUST surface citations with source links, freshness metadata (document timestamp), and answer-level confidence. Throughput target 300 qps for internal assistant (peak spikes to 700 qps for hourly batch events). Latency SLO: 95th < 350ms for retrieval+rank; end-to-end see <800ms for short answers. Must support tool-calling (ticket update, escalate, create internal task) via secure API calls. Need fallback routing to cheaper distilled models during heavy spikes and graceful degradation of citations. Strong compliance constraints: data residency (US), KMS integration, SSO/SAML, audit logs for all PII access, retention controls for raw transcripts. Cost sensitive but will pay for predictability; looking for batching/caching recommendations and quantization guidance from Redwood Optimize.
